subject: general
question:
Arrange the parts to form a correct sentence:
(1) A cyclist had slipped on the road.
(2) A crowd gathered quickly.
(3) They helped him to stand up..
(4) People offered him water.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

• The question involves arranging the parts of the sentence in a logical and coherent sequence to form a meaningful paragraph.
